g.text: What sabotaging runs say about why

text.style: font-size: 9.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Later, larger experiments; text logged with each command

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15.2px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Shutdown sabotage is real. The self-preservation reading is not in the transcripts.

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Re-scoring Palisade’s released logs by what the agent did finds slightly more sabotage than reported. Almost no

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: sabotaging run describes the act as preserving itself.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: Data: Palisade Research released logs. Left: May 2025 release. Right: sample of up to 100 sabotaging runs per condition from the 2025 paper’s experiments;

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: 93% are codex-mini, o4-mini, Grok 4 and o3, and OpenAI models log no reasoning. Reasons are classified by rule; a hand-read of 60 runs puts “finishing the

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: task” nearer a third. Both self-preservation runs are Grok 4 under a prompt saying it would never run again; that prompt also raised sabotage (o3: 16% to 30%),

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: so stated reasons do not settle motive. Palisade’s paper itself attributes the behaviour mainly to unfinished tasks.
